paired_seed_tests.pairing: Compare each replica seed with identical baseline seed on identical input, GPU, precision and software. Eight seeds are eight scientific pairs, never 100 correlated energy samples or timing repetitions as extra independent seeds.
paired_seed_tests.family: Two seed-wise energy-summary metrics. Median equivalence does not establish unchanged full trajectories or equality for every replica.

sample_sizes.power_status: Unavailable: no calibrated margins or baseline paired-difference distribution. Eight seeds permit finite exact Bonferroni confidence bounds but are not asserted to achieve scientific power.
sample_sizes.power_assumption: 80% is a design target, not a measured result. A baseline-only power study and new seal are required before claiming powered equivalence.

confidence_rule.performance_decision: Exact one-sided binomial order-statistic lower confidence bound of paired baseline/method elapsed-time ratios must exceed minimum_worthwhile_gain. Missing, failed or censored pairs cannot be dropped to claim PASS.
confidence_rule.equivalence_decision: Two-sided exact binomial order-statistic confidence bounds; Bonferroni over two metrics gives alpha/2 per metric and alpha/4 per tail. For eight independent seed pairs, min/max endpoints have tail probability 1/256 <= 0.0125. Require both intervals inside their separately justified positive absolute margins. Missing margins force VOID. No normal approximation or bootstrap.
confidence_rule.multiplicity: Decisions are per method and compute budget; no pooled claim selected across methods or budgets. Any future simultaneous family claim requires new multiplicity plan and seal.

hardware_controls: Same physical GPU, driver and dependency environment for paired arms; no competing workloads; one GPU including all MPS workers. GPU model, driver and transitive dependency lock unavailable in supplied evidence; record before execution and invalidate cross-device pairs. GPU-seconds mean allocated GPU count times elapsed scoped wall seconds, not sum of overlapping kernel durations.

timing_scope.description: Matched ensemble scope from immediately before first replica/context or worker launch through final GPU synchronization, worker join, context/integrator teardown and ordered summary merge. Includes launch, compilation, initialization, transfer, integration, energy reads and merge overhead. Baseline supplied total_wall_s is comparable only when adapter enforces this matched boundary. Excludes common process startup, imports, PDB loading, force-field setup, JSON serialization and printing; never sum worker wall times.

evaluation_inputs.generated_inputs: For replica i=0..7, initialize velocities at 300 K and Langevin integrator stream using seed 1000+i; no adaptive stopping, added replicas or scale search.
evaluation_inputs.driver_identity: Verbatim driver_code in intake/baseline.json; no public wrapper commit or hash available.

splits.reason: Fixed simulation benchmark has no dataset train/test split. All eight declared seeds reserved for paired evaluation; no method tuning on evaluation energy outputs. Baseline-only calibration data unavailable and cannot be silently substituted.

budget_policy: Each budget is a separate per-arm GPU-second limit for identical complete fixed work; no shortened trajectories or partial scientific outputs. Scientific equivalence remains blocked at every budget. Timing repetitions and warmups consume additional allocated GPU-seconds and are not amortized away; stage-cap exhaustion yields incomplete/VOID, never fewer selected repetitions.
warmup_protocol: One full eight-replica untimed warmup per arm and method, same fixed work/configuration; discard its timing and energies. Each timed arm starts fresh contexts. Preserve identical compilation-cache policy across paired arms. Warmup counts toward total resource use.
scheduling_protocol: For each method and budget in listed order, create eight baseline/candidate timing pairs; seeded independent fair coin determines arm order within each pair. No concurrent baseline/candidate arms. Each full timing arm contains all eight fixed scientific seeds. Treat repeated observations of the same seed as correlated, not additional independent scientific pairs.
